en.headline: 6 commits on sopen-translate: glossary, caching, perf, v0.2.0
en.summary: Activity on 2026-10-23 was concentrated in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, with **6 own commits** and no pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases. Work started with a page-level performance change that batches requests by provider policy, adds bounded concurrency and an adaptive split. Two maintenance commits followed: one added an ignore rule for locally installed agent skills, and one recorded C6 real-device acceptance results in the planning docs. A fix for options and popup keeps the model cache TTL honest and guards the restore status fetch. The release commit bumped the extension to `0.2.0` and synced docs with the bilingual and glossary work. The final feature commit shipped an offline-built builtin glossary term list with 797 entries. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there were no own commits; **9 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`** were recorded.

zh.headline: sopen-translate 提交 6 次：术语表、缓存、性能与 v0.2.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-23 的活动集中在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`，共 **6 次本人提交**，没有拉取请求、评审、issue 或发布。当天先做了页面级性能改动：按 provider 策略分批请求，并加入有界并发与自适应拆分。随后两个维护类提交，一个为本地安装的 agent skills 增加忽略规则，另一个在规划文档中记录 C6 真机验收结果。针对 options 和 popup 的修复让模型缓存 TTL 更准确，并为恢复状态请求加了保护。发布提交把扩展版本升到 `0.2.0`，并让文档与双语、术语表工作保持同步。最后一个功能提交上线了离线构建的内置术语表，共含 797 条词条。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 当天没有本人提交，但有 **9 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交**。
